race.title: Join The Southwell Racecourse Corporate Club Handicap Chase
race.verdict: IMPERIAL BEDE has plummeted to a career-low mark after a quiet spell and the cheekpieces he wore for the first time when last successful are back on. He's interesting for an in-form stable, all the more so if there is strength behind him in the betting. Grain Trade should stay this far and is a player, while last year's winner Bravethewaves could be a force in new headgear. IMPERIAL BEDE (FR) GRAIN TRADE BRAVETHEWAVES
race.bettingForecast: Henry Box Brown (4/1), Imperial Bede (5/1), Rap Soul (6/1), Grain Trade (13/2), Doors Breaker (7/1), Bravethewaves (7/1), Colby Mayfield (8/1), Four Decades (10/1), The Paddy Pie (12/1), Dynamite Defense (33/1)
